newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks ascend in morning, led by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks ascend in morning, led by blue chips.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ascended in early Tuesday morning trade, led by interest in blue-chip issues, brokers said, which were lifted by strength in U.S. markets overnight and weakness in the yen against the dollar.
As of 0017 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was up 57.60 points or 0.28 percent at 20,632.86. September Nikkei futures added 40 to 20,630.

"The yen is at about 117 (to the dollar) and global issues, especially high-priced ones that have been rising lately, will probably continue to be encouraged by this (the yen weakness)," Sanyo Securities general manager Mitsuru Hayashino said.
